acceptance: Dependency closure selects only relevant conformance tests, with a conservative full-test fallback for uncertain impact.

positive.fixture: a field change selects its tests and those of what is bound to it, not unrelated ones

negative.fixture: unknown class, unmapped path, subject outside the graph and uncovered subject each run every test

security_and_source_permissions: Selection can only add tests, never skip the always set.
known_limitations: Operations are not linked to semantic actions in the IR
